verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance SaaS platform that holds customer data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge capability. GDPR gap analysis and generated document packs (DPA, ROPA, DPIA) are adjacent compliance artifacts, not product controls over data retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
